I liked the location of the property. It’s in a very quiet neighborhood. It was a short commute from downtown Savannah. It was plenty of room for my friends and I to be comfortable.
The lock on the door gave us some trouble throughout the stay. But the owner was a great help with this issue. I believe the master bedroom had bedbugs. I got confirmation this morning from my doctor that these were the bites of bedbugs on my arms and legs. I did reach out to the owner when I found out but no response as of yet.
